newsitem.title: USA: Duff/Phelps reaffirms Kidder Peabody certificates.
newsitem.headline: Duff/Phelps reaffirms Kidder Peabody certificates.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Monday it reaffirmed ratings on the Kidder Peabody Acceptance Corp Series 1994-C2, Classes A, B, C, D and E commercial mortgage pass-through cetificates.
The ratings were removed from Duff & Phelps' "uncertain" rating watch.

The rated certificates represent ownership in a $100 million real estate mortgage insurance company originally formed by Tucker Financing Partnership, which in March became an indirect subsidiary of Bradley Real Estate and was renamed Bradley Financing Partnership.
Duff & Phelps said it reaffirmed current ratings on the certificates -- Class A at Triple A, Class B at Double A, Class C at Single A, Class D at Triple B and Class E at Double B.
